Our installation process

Understand how we approach flooring and waterproofing projects, from the first site discussion to curing and handover.

From site visit to handover

Every job starts by understanding the substrate and its intended use. The exact scope and sequence are confirmed for the selected system.

STEP 01

Site visit

Discuss the location, area, operational use, traffic, exposure, access restrictions, and preferred timeline.

STEP 02

Inspection

Assess concrete, cracks, movement joints, existing coating, contamination, and moisture. Identify additional investigation or repair needs.

STEP 03

Preparation

Agree mechanical preparation, cleaning, repairs, levelling, and detailing. Waterproofing jobs also require attention to joints, penetrations, drainage, and leakage sources.

STEP 04

Installation

Apply the specified system within its application limits. Product compatibility, layer sequence, cure between coats, and site conditions matter.

STEP 05

Handover

Review the completed scope and provide product-specific curing, return-to-service, cleaning, and maintenance guidance.

Plan your site assessment

Have your approximate area, current surface condition, and requirements ready for the discussion.
